resolutions.researcher_notes: Dead almasryalyoum.com link (403848, no Wayback snapshot exists per CDX check) replaced. Petroleum Africa (Jan 2011, on Mubarak's Dec 2010 Aswan inauguration) and The Australian Pipeliner (Sept 2009, on the line reaching Sohag) both describe the South Valley/Upper Egypt Gas Pipeline's 'first phase' as a pre-existing government-built pipeline 'from Cairo to a power station located near Beni Suef' that Nile Valley Gas Co. took over and extended -- i.e. the Al Kurimat(Koraimat)-Beni Suef segment (El-Koraimat power station sits in Giza governorate near the Beni Suef border) was already in place/operating years before the 2009-2010 milestones these two articles report. Corroborated further by the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum's official project page (Wayback-archived, see Length/Location refs) which lists this as completed 'Phase 2' infrastructure. Flagging for transparency: the two English trade articles share near-identical phase-history phrasing (both likely paraphrase the same Ministry of Petroleum/GASCO press materials), so true editorial independence is limited -- downgraded to tier=medium rather than high despite two distinct bylined/dated outlets. No contradiction to GEM's 'operating' status found.

The current live petroleum.gov.eg URL (also one of the wiki's seed citations) now 302-redirects (dead); the site's own strategic-projects page for this pipeline is preserved on Wayback (multiple 200 snapshots 2016-2019, confirmed via CDX). It states verbatim: 'Phase 2: El-Koraimat - Beni Suef Gas Pipeline (30 km length, 32" diameter)' -- an exact match to GEM's LengthKnown=30 km for this segment. This is the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum's own official/primary source (likely also the ultimate origin of the phase breakdown that gem.wiki's dead almasryalyoum ref and the Petroleum Africa/Pipeliner articles paraphrase), so I could not find a second, wholly independent outlet that separately breaks out this specific 30 km sub-segment (checked Egypt Oil & Gas, Pipeline & Gas Journal, World Bank/IFC environmental-assessment docs for the area -- none isolate this segment's length). Tier held at medium (single strong/authoritative primary source) rather than high. No contradiction found; value confirmed as stated.

Ministry of Petroleum's official (Wayback-archived) project page explicitly names 'Phase 2: El-Koraimat - Beni Suef Gas Pipeline,' confirming both endpoints (El-Koraimat/Al Kurimat and Beni Suef) by name; the overall pipeline is described as running Dahshour (Giza governorate) to Aswan, consistent with StartState/Province=Giza. Petroleum Africa corroborates the broader geography ('extension from Giza to Aswan'; 'first phase... from Cairo to a power station located near Beni Suef') but does not use the toponym 'Al Kurimat/Koraimat' itself, so it supports the Giza-to-Beni Suef corridor rather than confirming the exact place-name independently. El-Koraimat (also transliterated Kuraymat/Kureimat) is a well-known power-station town in Giza governorate on the Nile, consistent with StartLocation/StartState-Province. Held at tier=medium given the naming corroboration rests on one primary (ministry) source. No contradiction found.
